title: Protecting the Local River
text:
Many communities now take action to protect the environment near their homes. In one town, volunteers began cleaning the local river every Saturday morning. They collected plastic bottles, old tyres and other waste that had been polluting the water for years.

The project soon grew into a larger campaign. Local schools joined the effort, and students started measuring the water quality each month. The results showed that the river was slowly becoming cleaner, which encouraged many residents to take part in future activities.

questions.text: When did the volunteers clean the local river?
What did the local schools start doing as part of the project?
options: Measuring the water quality each month

questions.text: What can the reader infer about the river before the volunteers started cleaning it?
options: It was perfectly clean and safe
It had been polluted for a long time
It had recently been moved to a new place
It was too deep for anyone to enter

questions.text: Why did the improving river encourage more residents to take part?
options: Because the project was ending soon
Because they wanted to earn money
Because they could see that their efforts were making a difference

vocabulary.definition: people who offer their time to help without being paid
harmful substances that make air, water or land dirty
an organised series of actions to achieve a goal

paragraph_translations: Багато громад зараз вживають заходів для захисту довкілля поблизу своїх домівок. В одному місті волонтери почали щосуботи ранку прибирати місцеву річку. Вони збирали пластикові пляшки, старі шини та інші відходи, які роками забруднювали воду.

Проєкт невдовзі переріс у ширшу кампанію. Місцеві школи долучилися до справи, і учні почали щомісяця вимірювати якість води. Результати показали, що річка поступово стає чистішою, що заохотило багатьох мешканців брати участь у майбутніх заходах.
